title: Business acumen: speaking the company’s language

videos.script: An analyst says late first deliveries more than double early cancellations. A finance director hears a percentage, and waits for the number she actually works with. {{waits}} That number is money. Not revenue, which is what customers pay. Margin, which is what is left after the food and the shipping. {{money}} Business acumen is knowing how your company turns customers into margin, well enough to place your finding on that path. {{path}} This lesson builds Faro's path. What a box earns. How long a customer stays. What it costs to win one. {{build}} Then it puts the first box on the path, and turns 41.5% into the R$ 790 thousand of lesson 4, step by step, in a spreadsheet you can check. {{steps}}
